messages:
sarah: FYI we're seeing a spike of 401s in the Galileo preprod POC after the opt-in schema update. Customer demo tomorrow, need immediate triage. @raj can you jump in? :eyes:
raj: on it. which endpoint and any error snippets? I can flip tracing on and check auth header parsing.
sarah: /v1/generate and /v1/chat both throwing 401s. Happens for a subset of tokens. Customer says it started after we rolled schema v2.
lisa: customer asked about contract timelines earlier — if this drags into tomorrow demo it'll likely delay sign-off. Can we get a fallback plan?
emma: quick security note: if this is related to token audience (aud) change we need to confirm SSO mapping; I can validate the JWKS config.
raj: pulling logs now. enable request_id tracing? jim, can you enable the preprod trace flag?
jim: enabled trace: flag preprod/galileo/tracing=true 
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T14:07Z started by sarah (canary) - sha: a7f3b2d - rolling to preprod
raj: log tail: ```
2026-03-21T14:09:12Z ERROR auth middleware: token validation failed: invalid_claims: expected aud=redwood-galileo, got aud=redwood-inference
2026-03-21T14:09:12Z WARN request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate status=401
```
raj: looks like tokens minted for old audience. schema v2 bumped client_id and token issuer?
emma: yes, schema v2 updated client_id -> galileo-client and we rotated the issuer mapping last night. If the client didn't rotate their token provider they'll get wrong aud.
lisa: customer said they did a manual deploy of their auth provider yesterday — likely mismatched. Can we provide a config snippet for quick fix to their IdP? I can send to their SRE.
raj: quick mitigation: add a compatibility check that accepts both aud values for preprod. I'll push a short-lived rule guarded by a feature flag. Needs a patch + restart of auth service.
sarah: timeline? how long to patch and redeploy?
raj: patch in <20m, deploy canary in 10m after build, validate with 10 requests. If good, rollout to all preprod.
emma: after patch, we should rotate long-term mapping in config and notify customer to update tokens. I'll prepare an email template and the JWKS entries.
lisa: also need to confirm pricing impact if we extend extra support hours for demo. SalesOps: we may need to log a billable support add-on. @sarah please confirm.
sarah: noted — will log the support add-on and notify account team.
jim: canary deployed, auth-service pod restarted, canary logs show 200s for the sample token set.
raj: running load and smoke tests now, sending curl examples: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://preprod.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```
raj: smoke looks clean for mixed aud tokens. rolling patch to remaining preprod instances.
deploy-bot: rollout complete - canary=ok - 3/3 preprod instances updated.
sarah: great work. action items: raj -> open PR to make compat flag expire in 7 days and add alert if audience mismatch >2% after expiry; emma -> send JWKS + template to customer SRE; lisa -> confirm support add-on with SalesOps; jim -> keep tracing enabled until tomorrow morning demo.
emma: sending email draft to customer now and cc'ing account team.
lisa: I'll prepare a one-pager for the customer on token rotation steps + timeline.
raj: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/auth-service/pull/482 - preprod compatibility feature flag + tests.
sarah: thanks everyone. keep updates here and tag me for any blocking regressions. :thumbsup:
